item.description: To create discourse on gender and art, FII is looking for submissions throughout the month until the 25th of January, 2026. The post Gender And Art: Mood Of The Month January 2026 appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Can Stress and Lifestyle Cause Severe Hair Fall in Women? Here’s What Doctors Say
item.description: Hair loss sneaks up on women more than we talk about. Stress and daily habits play significant roles in Hair Fall… The post Can Stress and Lifestyle Cause Severe Hair Fall in Women? Here’s What Doctors Say appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Is ‘Body Positivity’ Just Another Standard For Upper Castes And Able Bodies?
item.description: There is a lack of intersectionality in mainstream body positivity which focuses on beauty standards and not caste-based, ableist oppression. The post Is ‘Body Positivity’ Just Another Standard For Upper Castes And Able Bodies? appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Why The ‘Female Gaze’ Doesn’t Exist
item.description: The female gaze cannot and does not exist, as it does not embody the systemic dissonance in power. The post Why The ‘Female Gaze’ Doesn’t Exist appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: ‘Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai’ Means Well — But Misses Caste and Class Realities of Queer Lives
item.description: 'Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai' is Tamil cinema’s second lesbian feature film, a milestone signalling a long-overdue shift toward better queer representation, rather than reducing queer characters to a laughing stock. The post ‘Kadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai’ Means Well — But Misses Caste and Class Realities of Queer Lives appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Jargons And Justifications: Kuldeep Sengar’s Bail By The Delhi HC In The Unnao Rape Case
item.description: The developments in the Unnao rape case show how survivors of sexual violence continue to battle retraumatisation by the system, everyday. The post Jargons And Justifications: Kuldeep Sengar’s Bail By The Delhi HC In The Unnao Rape Case appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Sahir Ludhianvi, Dhurandhar’s Violence, And The Memeification Of Dissent
item.description: The ghazal has been chopped up, remixed as “Karwaan”. It reduces Muslims and Pakistanis to a monolith. The post Sahir Ludhianvi, Dhurandhar’s Violence, And The Memeification Of Dissent appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Colonialism And Silenced Motherlines: Gender, Memory, And Knowledge
item.description: Colonialism has tried to replace matrilineal memory with patriarchal order. But it lives on in our stories, our soil, and our acts of survival. The post Colonialism And Silenced Motherlines: Gender, Memory, And Knowledge appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Unpacking The Ableism Of Employment Market And Its Implications For Inclusion And Access
item.description: Inclusion is not simply a matter of policy, intent or installing some infrastructure to enable access for certain physical disabilities. The post Unpacking The Ableism Of Employment Market And Its Implications For Inclusion And Access appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: ‘Single Salma’ Review: Charting Self-Love As A Feminist Revolution
item.description: 'Single Salma' breaks the norm of treating singlehood as a burden and reframes it as an agential choice many women choose in today’s modern world, considering they do not wish to live a life like their mothers, who were forced to lead a life against their wishes. The post ‘Single Salma’ Review: Charting Self-Love As A Feminist Revolution appeared first on Feminism in India.
